palette.mood: Sunlit sage, viridian, sea-glass and apricot: hopeful daylight where both informed choices remain warm.
palette.divergence: No oxblood/parchment/brass credential press or aubergine/cosmic-rose signal space. Architectural sage occupies the frame; apricot marks human permission without coding refusal as danger.

light.direction: Upper-left broad cream key; soft viridian bounce; apricot edge on moving linkage
light.depth: Rear window and wall z=-180; human room z=0; small recorder/desk z=85; near arch z=160. Cast contact shadows connect actors to the same floor.

shape_language.grammar: Large continuous rounded human-care platform; small detachable rectangular clerical sidecar. Round coils are recordings, ivory sheets are approved notes, dotted rounded wave fragments are possible reuse.
shape_language.why: A machine can leave the composition without breaking the people-to-people space.

motion_language.grammar: Paper first overwhelms, then slides into a subordinate tray. Lever performs a deliberate arc; reels respond. Humans lean toward each other while attention moves away from clerical work.
hero_moves: Opening paper-wave bends toward a waiting lever without answering NO
Draft shuttles back for a visible review/edit before chart acceptance
Recording split opens into a dotted MAY branch distinct from the note
Source-notice pullback exposes the limits of the demonstration
Lever brakes OFF; detached recorder travels aside while the same-sized room is revealed intact
motion_language.blur: Brief directional blur only on paper-wave and recorder slide; lever arc uses anticipation and damped settle.

composition.staging: Four sets: cropped recorder macro, sunlit care room, overhead artifact workbench, tilted source-notice desk. Sidecar continually smaller than care; 14 shots alternate insert/wide/close/overhead/extreme-wide.
composition.safe_area: Critical composition x120..960 y500..1260, caption band y1336..1468. Full-height room context remains visible outside square crop but no critical claim lives there.
composition.signature_shot: The apparent clinic demonstration shrinks onto a dated public announcement: an appealing model, not a measured result. Later the recorder moves out while both people stay in the same light.
composition.focal_hierarchy: One focal action per shot at x540 y850. Quiet architectural space surrounds people; recording sidecar stays visibly smaller. Macro inserts fill the safe square when artifact identity matters; no floating UI grid competes with faces.
composition.attribution: ILLUSTRATION · TCC TERMS persists over every hypothetical care scene. Source date labels the announcement scene. OFF does not improve, enlarge or brighten care: same geometry, light and dignity.
